findings.description: Evaluated expected canonical columns in SA02601_visitation. Missing: []
findings.impact: Downstream pipeline failure if required survey attributes are absent.
findings.remediation: Ensure source CSV contains required columns or remap via PipelineConfig. Missing: []

findings.description: Evaluated expected canonical columns in SA02602_flowering. Missing: []
findings.impact: Downstream pipeline failure if required survey attributes are absent.
findings.remediation: Ensure source CSV contains required columns or remap via PipelineConfig. Missing: []

findings.description: Format mismatch in SA02601_visitation: Expected format '%d-%m-%Y' failed on 74942 rows. Auto-detection identified actual raw format as '%Y-%m-%d' (100% match with 'YEAR').
findings.impact: Pipeline execution with default config '%d-%m-%Y' will immediately crash. Must set PipelineConfig.vis_date_fmt = '%Y-%m-%d'.
findings.remediation: Update PipelineConfig(vis_date_fmt='%Y-%m-%d') when running pipeline on this dataset version.

findings.description: Evaluated SA02602_flowering 'SAMPLEDATE' with format '%Y-%m-%d'. Failed parsing: 0. Contradicted 'YEAR': 0.
findings.impact: Silent date corruption; links events to incorrect field seasons or chronologies.
findings.remediation: Verify expected date format string ('%Y-%m-%d'). Remember SA02601 and SA02602 may have varying formats across EDI release versions.

findings.description: Checked if PPI_STATUS is strictly binary {0, 1}.
findings.impact: Unknown record type; invalid status breaks E+ / E0 partitioning.
findings.remediation: Sanitize raw codes to {0: absence, 1: confirmed interaction}.

findings.description: Verified that PPI_STATUS=1 records contain non-null plant and pollinator species.
findings.impact: Interactions cannot be mapped to bipartite graph nodes without species identifiers.
findings.remediation: Impute or drop unidentifiable visitor/plant interaction rows.

findings.description: Verified that structural negatives (PPI_STATUS=0) have null species codes.
findings.impact: Contradiction: record flagged as empty watch but lists a species.
findings.remediation: Review if record is an interaction with wrong status flag or stray plant entry.

findings.description: Audited NO_INT in positive interactions for missing or non-positive counts.
findings.impact: Algorithm 2 substitutes missing counts with 1. Causes slight variation in raw totals.
findings.remediation: Apply fillna(1) as prescribed by Algorithm 2 in paper.

findings.description: Audited NO_FLWS in flowering records. Negative: 0, Null: 2154.
findings.impact: Negative counts are physical impossibilities; nulls require fillna(0) for log1p.
findings.remediation: Impute null flower counts to 0; investigate origin of any negative values.

findings.description: Visited plant species missing from flowering survey catalog: []
findings.impact: Interactions on these plants cannot compute phenological confidence and rely purely on default fallback (0.5).
findings.remediation: Harmonize species taxonomic codes across both datasets (check synonyms or typo suffixes).

findings.description: Watch sessions surveyed for pollinator visits that have NO corresponding record in flowering survey.
findings.impact: Indicates asynchronous sampling sessions or unsynchronized data entry.
findings.remediation: Fall back to prior flowering observation (LOCF) for that plot-season.

findings.description: Plant interaction records lacking same-session flowering record: 107 (0.175%). Paper observed ~0.24% requiring LOCF fallback.
findings.remediation: Confirm Algorithm 6 join_with_fallback resolves these without unintended defaults.

findings.description: Plots assigned to contradictory meadows or complexes across files: 5.
findings.impact: Corrupts spatial partitioning and meadow-stratified detection probability analysis.
findings.remediation: Standardize spatial lookup metadata table and enforce foreign keys.

findings.description: Found 7591 plant-pollinator pairs with multiple minute-level visits in the same watch (41007 extra rows collapsed into 20018 watch-level events).
findings.impact: Explains the reduction from 61,025 raw positive rows to ~20,025 watch-level positive events.
findings.remediation: Ensure GroupSum(..., value=NO_INT) is performed as prescribed in Algorithm 7.

findings.description: Negative events exist at two different granularities: 13917 raw minute-level rows vs 1389 deduplicated watch sessions. (Paper Table 1 cited 1,389; Section 2.2 cited 13,917).
findings.impact: Users expecting 1,389 negative rows will encounter schema confusion when seeing 13,917 rows.
findings.remediation: Export both granularities explicitly or document that 1,389 is deduplicated by (PLOT_ID, YEAR, WATCH).

findings.description: Evaluated lambda-grid ceiling of 80.0. Maximum single-watch count observed = 1770. Groups at risk of boundary pinning: 4399 (25.18%).
findings.impact: Silently pins posterior mean lambda_hat at grid ceiling, artificially squashing strongest edges.
findings.remediation: Widen PipelineConfig.lam_grid upper ceiling to at least 5000 (currently evaluated: 80.0).

findings.description: Species with zero variance in flower counts: 38 (18.81%).
findings.impact: Min-max normalization yields 0/0; triggers neutral 0.5 confidence fallback in Algorithm 5.
findings.remediation: Confirm Algorithm 5 handles degenerate species via the 0.5 fallback condition.

findings.description: Multi-year hiatus detected over survey horizon [2011-2021]. Unsampled years: [2019, 2020].
findings.impact: Naive calendar-based train/val/test splits produce empty partitions or invalid temporal decay.
findings.remediation: Use cumulative event volume splitting (Algorithm 8) over continuous elapsed time tau.
